title: The Russians, they’d only be an eight o’clock breakfast for the Japanese.
html_source:
This book is set in the year 1904, the same year as the Russo-Japanese War, which is what this line, an imitation of stilted small talk, is in reference to.

FYI, the Russians got their asses kicked.

anchor.text: The Russians, they'd only be an eight o'clock breakfast for the Japanese.
